<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the M+2 peak is ~33 % of the base peak, matching the characteristic 3:1 ratio of a single chlorine atom (35Cl/37Cl). The significant M+1 peak (~16 % of the base) aligns with the natural 13C abundance multiplied by many carbon atoms, indicating carbon is present. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic signature in this spectrum. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are chlorine and carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
